A busy season of good news
Our lead trainer raised a detail about desk cover overnight
Calm paws, quick checks, and steady handoffs are keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways in good shape. The welcome team is moving fast, keeping guidance short, kind, and easy to follow so travelers and pets can get through the day without extra fuss. <<FACT F019>> If you are coordinating a handoff, keep crates labeled, documents ready, and transport notes clear so the next shift can pick up without a stumble.

We are seeing strong teamwork across the floor, and that matters when the schedule tightens. Sana Yilmaz, Samuel Bianchi, and Marley have all been part of a smooth week, but the real win is the way everyone is watching for small issues before they turn into delays. Please keep your focus sharp, speak up early, and pass along any change as soon as it lands. When we stay organized and alert, the whole travel day gets easier for pets, staff, and travelers alike.
